summary: A seat shown as down says since when it last reported, not since it launched days earlier

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; the card is computed from existing claims at read time.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; the card's field names and types are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: No client or member change is required. The meaning of down_since changes from when the seat began waiting to when it last reported after its launch, so it reads later than before for a seat that reported after launching; clients that print it as a time need no change.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
